raised.claim: parseScopeBlock always takes the first ```triage-scope block via BLOCK_RE.exec; new_issue bodies are free text from the model and can contain the fence string.

ANALYSIS_TOOL_SCHEMA declares scope.where[].value as string|number|null for every term, but ScopeTermSchema requires a number for NUMERIC_COLS terms and omits value entirely for empty/non_empty/is_null terms.
raised.why_it_breaks: A model response that supplies a numeric term with value as a JSON string (allowed by the tool schema) reaches ScopeSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(...)) inside the llm path; the parse fails, AnalysisSchema fails, the run errors, and triage falls through to the transient-error path instead of producing a plan.

raised.claim: Inside the TEXT_COLS branch, term.value is accessed without a guard after only checking op, but the discriminated union for TEXT_COLS still includes the no-value empty/non_empty shape.
raised.why_it_breaks: If a term that reached the contains test has no value property at runtime (e.g. malformed tool output or future schema drift), term.value is undefined and the call throws, turning a scope check into an unhandled exception in planTriageActions.

raised.claim: Guard 2 treats an unscoped existing issue (scope===null) as a scope_violation and skips the verdict, but the count of such issues is never logged separately from real predicate violations.
raised.why_it_breaks: After the one-time backfill step the log line only shows guardHits.scope_violation; an operator cannot distinguish "still waiting for backfill" from "row actually contradicts the scope" without re-parsing the bodies themselves.
